rationale: The POSITIVE half of the artifact_ref $comment, made executable. Document 16 section 14.5 says an ArtifactRef 'carries its semantic role, classification, and rights snapshot', and the only reading that validates is the nested one: the enclosing slot is an object holding the ref under one member with the further members BESIDE it. artifact_output is the released instance of that shape -- payload_digest sits beside artifact_ref, not inside it -- and the ref it holds is a typed-refs:1 artifact_ref by construction, since its schema_ref is the pinned const. The inline reading is refused by typed-ref-artifact-carrying-slot-members-inline.
